description: Process b holds a snapshot, dynaset, forward-only and table-type cursor over rows 1, 2 and 64 opened before any transaction. Process a begins a transaction and updates N of row 1; b reads each held cursor (Move 0, read, Transactions) and opens new cursors. Process a commits; b reads the held cursors without Requery, then Requery on each and reads, then new cursors. Process a begins, updates and has b read (held cursors without Requery, new cursors), then rolls back; b reads without and then with Requery. Asks membership, value and refresh timing for readers on both sides of another process's commit and rollback.
retentionNote: Designed r-lock-3-4-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
